crossRefs.note: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve…
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good…
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship…
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship…
We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother…

translations.web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
translations.bsb: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
translations.kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
translations.asv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.
